## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of what changes this Pull Request introduces.

- Fixes #(issue)
- Closes #(issue)

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests or QA enhancements
- [ ] ⚙️ CI/CD or packaging improvements

---

## Verification & Testing

Please describe the tests you ran to verify your changes:

- [ ] All unit tests pass: `uv run pytest`
- [ ] Code formatting and linting pass: `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] Static type checker passes: `uv run mypy src`
- [ ] Manual test run completed with sample input (if applicable)

---

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or lint errors.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes.
- [ ] No API keys, secrets, or personal credentials are committed.
